page0.text:
"...All right, I'll be honest.
But first, let me be clear about something. I don't know how to flatter or say things to make people like me, so I'd appreciate it if you keep that in mind."

page1.text:
I fix Rider with a serious stare.
She's as unreadable as ever, but she seems to understand that I'm being serious.

page2.text:
"I'll just say it—I don't hold a grudge against you, Rider, and I don't mind if you eat with us, either. I don't know how to approach you, Rider, but I'm rather fond of you."
I fight down my nervousness and say it clearly.

page3.text: "...You can't mean that. Aren't you afraid of me?"

page4.text:
"Sure I am. You scare me, but you're on our side.
You've already saved me once, and you fought to protect Sakura at the school. I can't hate you for that... I'm just not sure how to approach you."

page5.text: "...I fail to understand, but you don't appear to be lying... I'll ask one more time. Aren't you afraid of me?"

page6.text:
"I said I am. I've seen firsthand how fearsome of a Servant you are.
...But, it feels like you're all right on the inside, like you're similar to Sakura, somehow. So I think I can trust you, and I hope you'll keep protecting Sakura. I'm just not sure how to deal with you, personally."

page7.text:
Urgh...that sounded like a romantic confession.
I feel like she'll ask me the same question again if I look her in the eyes, so I'd better turn away and play this—
...Wait.
Oh crap, what am I saying in front of Sakura!?

page8.text:
"It's not what you think, Sakura. I was just talking about my preferences, not saying that I—"
"I don't care. Now I know that you're flirtatious and have a weak spot for beautiful women."

page9.text:
"Mrgh."
Wow.
Is this the first time Sakura has ever looked this upset with me?

page10.text:
"Hold on, calm down. I like Rider as a person, not as a woman. You trust her, right? I feel the same way.
Besides, to me, you're actually the prettier one. Compared to Rider, I'd say—"

page11.text: Whoa, w-what was that incredible hostility I just felt from Rider!?

page12.text:
"...Um, that you're in no way any less beautiful, and I don't think it's right to compare people to each other."
...Uh oh.
The more I run my mouth, the deeper I seem to dig my grave.

page13.text:
"...Actually, never mind. This isn't something to talk about over breakfast. I suggest we change the topic."
I raise my hands pleadingly.
Depending on how you see it, it could be a complete surrender.

page14.text:
"No, we're not finished yet. This is a good chance to find out how you really feel, Senpai."
"I agree with Sakura. It's a trivial matter to me, but we ought to clarify this."
Both of them lean in toward me.

page15.text:
"Senpai. Do you like me or Rider more?
I'm sure you know what your own feelings are."
Ah.

page16.text:
"Sakura is right. It's a trivial matter, but I'm interested in your answer as well."
Oof.

page17.text:
"Let's hear your answer!"
I feel my back against the wall.
I have no way out, and I know that the moment I open my mouth, I'm bound to piss one of them off.
